text:
The shape with three sides is a triangle.

Here is a funny anecdote based on the text:

Chris walked into the gym with the swagger of a man who had just watched one motivational YouTube video. He spotted the new weight machine and decided it was time to prove he wasn't just there for the smoothie bar. With the confidence of a seasoned bodybuilder, he strapped himself in, only to realize too late that he had somehow become best friends with the machine.

What followed was not a workout, but a very awkward, silent hug. Chris was essentially locked in an embrace with the contraption, his face pressed against the console as he frantically searched for a release button that seemed to have gone on strike. From the outside, it looked less like "man versus machine" and more like "man trying to negotiate a peace treaty with metal." The nearby gym-goers didn't even stop their sets; they just paused to enjoy the free comedy show. Chris eventually freed himself, slightly red-faced, and muttered, "I think it likes me," before quickly changing into his sweatpants and leaving.
